name: Trol'kalar

narrative.details:
What's this? With the four sigils brought together, they have formed together to create one sigil. There can be no doubt that this will be able to break the wardings placed upon Trollbane's tomb.

Trollbane's remains are entombed in the Sanctum behind the chapel in Stromgarde. Retrieve Trol'kalar.
narrative.objectives: Retrieve Trol'kalar from Trollbane's tomb in Stromgarde.
narrative.offerRewardText: Matching the lines on the face of Trollbane's tomb with the glowing lines of the Sigil of Ignaeus, a flash of light consumes the Sigil, and the legendary sword Trol'kalar is released from the stone hands' grip.
narrative.requestItemsText: Etchings in the stone upon the face of the tomb of Trollbane match the glowing lines of the Sigil of Ignaeus...

quests.name: Trollbane
quests.objectiveText: Travel to Hammerfall in the Arathi Highlands and speak with Zengu.

quests.name: The Broken Sigil
quests.objectiveText: Retrieve the 5 Sigil Fragments from the defenders in Stromgarde, and bring them to Tor'gan in Hammerfall.

quests.name: Sigil of Thoradin
quests.objectiveText: Bring the restored Sigil of Thoradin to Zengu in Hammerfall.

quests.name: Sigil of Arathor
